fa13e8954d test: Fix block height typos in test logs

NODE_NETWORK_LIMITED_MIN_BLOCKS includes two blocks of buffer, so the
"tip-288" and "tip-289" comments were wrong. Also, the first mined block
is at height 1, not height 2.

fadcd0b64e test: Remove confusing ensure_for

There is no "trickle delay" for blocks, so a single ping should be
sufficient to drain any possible in-flight blocks.

Remvoe the ensure_for and directly assert the outcome.
